title: 第3章 天穹之上的倩影第4章 修行路
slug: 人在玄幻写日记我真不是曹贼啊
content_zh:
心中有所猜测，但楚歌并未妄下决断，只是静静观察。
周遭对于叶辰的嘲讽不绝于耳。
楚歌更是看到那唐山凑到叶辰身边，口中不断说着话，脸上带着狞笑。
颇有种无脑小反派的既视感。
而那叶辰，脸上自始至终毫无波澜，好似他人的话语未对他造成丝毫影响。
“肃静，吵吵闹闹，成何体统！”
台上，邢风眉头一皱，口中话音如洪钟大吕，敲在所有人心尖。
霎时间，场面便安静了下来，那嘲讽叶辰最凶的几人，包括唐山，都是面色苍白，心神震荡。
【发现一位疑似气运之子的少年，出场便被群嘲。】
【我有种预感，待会儿这叶辰测试过后，便是他扬眉吐气，反转打脸一众人的时刻。】
楚歌心中嘀咕着，将其随手记录在日记上。
而关注着此处情况的一众拥有日记副本的女修，也将注意力放在了测灵台上。
心底对楚歌口中疑似气运之子的叶辰产生了些许好奇。
苏灵鸢此刻藏匿起了自身，同样关注着事情发展。
‘当真有这么玄乎？不过说来确实有些怪，哪有人一上来就被所有人讥讽的？’
她心中嘀咕着，继续观望，想要看看待会儿会不会如楚歌日记中记载的那般，迎来反转。
同时也不忘扫视人群，想要提前找到楚歌。
她如今的状态不好动用神念与灵力，因此只得用肉眼寻找，只是人影绰绰，根本没有丝毫发现，令她有些懊恼。
台上，邢风目光落到缓步登台的叶辰，眼中闪过赞许之色。
心中暗道:‘此子小小年纪，面对讥讽却是不卑不亢，面如平湖，心怀沟壑，当真气度非凡，想来纵使根骨差些，未必就不能有一番成就，当真是难能可贵。’

一念至此，他声音都柔和了些，一改先前的冷硬姿态。
“将手放上测灵石上吧。”
叶辰闻言，神色平静，眼中却是闪烁着坚毅。
所有的讥讽，嘲弄，曾经受过的屈辱，自今日开始，他要一一洗刷干净！
在下方一众或讥讽，或冷淡，或怨毒的目光注视下，叶辰缓缓将手放上测灵石。
下一刻，自测灵石之上，绽放出耀眼红光！
红光大绽，映照在所有人脸上，自光芒之中，好似有蛟龙虚影潜藏！
“潜蛟王体！”
邢风忍不住惊呼一声，神色激动。
下方，一众先前讥讽叶辰之人，此刻更是被刺目的红光照射的睁不开眼。
特别是当叶辰转过身，自高台上俯瞰他们之时，更是令他们有种自惭形秽之感。
忍不住低下头去，不敢与此刻锋芒毕露的叶辰对视！
叶辰嘴角勾起一抹夸张弧度，极为邪魅。
“好好好，如此根骨，想来会引起一番长老们的争抢，叶辰，你且到我身旁来，待到测试结束，我便亲自为你引荐一众有收徒意愿的长老！”
邢风脸上带着笑意，完全没了此前冷硬的形象。
“多谢邢风长老。”
叶辰拱手拜谢，笑容和煦，礼数也极为周到。
邢风见眼前少年浑然没有寻常少年天骄的骄横和张狂，心中更是满意，不由生出了些许想法。
他却是不知，叶辰心底真正想法。
此刻的叶辰，心底对邢风是颇为不屑的。

尽管这位邢长老对他有些另眼相待的意味。
但他已经瞧出了些许端倪。
content_en:
There were some guesses in his mind, but Chu Ge did not make any hasty decisions, he just observed quietly.
The ridicule towards Ye Chen was endless.
Chu Ge even saw Tangshan approaching Ye Chen, talking constantly with a sinister smile on his face.
It has a sense of déjà vu as a brainless villain.
As for Ye Chen, his face remained calm from beginning to end, as if other people's words had not affected him at all.
"Silence, noisy, how unbecoming!"
On the stage, Xing Feng frowned, and his words sounded like a bell, striking everyone's heart.
In an instant, the scene became quiet. The people who mocked Ye Chen the most, including Tang Shan, were all pale and shaken.
[A young man suspected to be the son of luck was found, and he was laughed at by the crowd when he appeared. 】
[I have a hunch that after Ye Chen passes the test later, it will be his moment to be proud and slap everyone in the face. 】
Chu Ge muttered in his heart and wrote it down in his diary.
The female cultivators who had copies of the diary and were paying attention to the situation here also focused their attention on the spirit detection platform.
In the bottom of his heart, he was a little curious about Ye Chen, whom Chu Ge said was the son of fate.
Su Lingyuan hid herself at this moment and was also paying attention to the development of things.
‘Is it really that mysterious? But it is indeed a bit strange. How can someone be ridiculed by everyone as soon as he comes up? ’
She murmured in her heart and continued to wait and see, hoping to see if there would be a reversal as recorded in Chu Ge's diary.
At the same time, he did not forget to scan the crowd, hoping to find Chu Ge in advance.
She was not in a good condition to use her mind and spiritual power, so she had to look for it with her naked eyes. However, she couldn't find the figure at all, which made her a little annoyed.
On the stage, Xing Feng's eyes fell on Ye Chen, who was slowly walking on the stage, and a look of approval flashed in his eyes.
I thought to myself: 'This boy is so young, yet he is neither humble nor arrogant when faced with ridicule. His face is as flat as a lake, and his heart is as deep as a ravine. He really has extraordinary magnanimity. Even if he has a weak base, he may not be unable to achieve something. This is really commendable. ’
As soon as he thought about this, his voice became softer, changing his previous cold attitude.
"Put your hands on the spiritual stone."
When Ye Chen heard this, his expression was calm, but his eyes shone with perseverance.
Starting from today, he will wash away all the sarcasm, ridicule, and humiliation he has suffered!
Under the gazes of the people below who were either sarcastic, cold, or resentful, Ye Chen slowly put his hand on the spirit-testing stone.
The next moment, a dazzling red light bloomed on the self-test spirit stone!
A red light bloomed, reflecting on everyone's faces. In the light, there seemed to be a phantom of a dragon lurking!
"Hidden Dragon King Body!"
Xing Feng couldn't help but exclaimed, looking excited.
Below, the people who had previously ridiculed Ye Chen were unable to open their eyes under the dazzling red light.
Especially when Ye Chen turned around and looked down at them from the high platform, they felt even more ashamed of themselves.
I couldn't help but lower my head, not daring to look at Ye Chen who was showing off his sharp edge at this moment!
The corner of Ye Chen's mouth curled up in an exaggerated arc, which was extremely evil.
"Okay, okay, with such a strong foundation, I think it will cause a fight among the elders. Ye Chen, please come to me. When the test is over, I will personally introduce you to a group of elders who are willing to accept disciples!"
Xing Feng had a smile on his face, completely losing his previous cold image.
"Thank you, Elder Xing Feng."
Ye Chen bowed his hands and thanked him, with a warm smile and extremely thoughtful etiquette.
Xing Feng was even more satisfied when he saw that the young man in front of him did not have the arrogance and arrogance of ordinary young geniuses, and he couldn't help but have some ideas.
But he didn't know what Ye Chen was really thinking in his heart.
At this moment, Ye Chen was quite disdainful of Xing Feng.
Although Elder Xing treated him somewhat differently.
But he had already seen some clues.
